description: A Polymer micro-element definition file that registers custom elements and manages component lifecycle, behaviors, and attributes.

classes.name: Polymer
classes.description: Main namespace object for Polymer functionality, including configuration and class registration.

classes.name: Polymer.Base
classes.description: Provides base class methods and lifecycle callbacks for Polymer elements, including property handling, behaviors, and attribute serialization.

classes.name: Polymer.RenderStatus
classes.description: Manages the rendering lifecycle of Polymer components, including ready callbacks and render queue.

classes.name: Polymer.ImportStatus
classes.description: Tracks the status of HTML imports, synchronized with render status.

classes.name: Polymer.telemetry
classes.description: Collects telemetry data about Polymer component registration and instance count.

classes.name: Polymer.Class
classes.description: Alias for the function responsible for class creation and registration.

classes.name: Polymer.CaseMap
classes.description: Utility object for converting between camelCase and dash-case.

methods.name: Settings
methods.description: Evaluates user configuration options based on URL parameters.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a custom element based on a prototype object.

methods.name: desugar
methods.description: Processes a prototype to produce a constructor and setup necessary registration.

methods.name: whenReady
methods.description: Executes a callback when the rendering lifecycle is ready.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Initializes feature setup and lifecycle hooks for Polymer classes.
